Marvell single-source risk customer diversify supplier Trainium Maia 2026

findings.claim: 10-Q 風險揭露：AWS 為 Marvell 最大客戶且差距顯著；Trainium 放緩或轉向其他設計夥伴將對營收造成重大影響。
findings.source: Marvell 10-Q FY2026 (quarter ended 2026-05-02), via search summary
findings.excerpt: AWS is Marvell's largest customer by a significant margin. A slowdown in the Trainium program or a shift to a different design partner would have a material impact on revenue.

findings.claim: Marvell 風險揭露警告部分大客戶可能自行開發並製造半導體方案，導致 Marvell 失去業務。
findings.source: Marvell 10-Q FY2026 (quarter ended 2026-05-02), via search summary
findings.excerpt: some large customers may begin developing and making their own semiconductor solutions which could result in a loss of business for Marvell

findings.claim: Benchmark 降評稱 Marvell 將 Trainium 3 與 4 設計輸給台灣 Alchip；未經公司證實。
findings.source: AOL/Barron's-type coverage: Will Customer Defections Crumble Marvell Technology's AI Empire?
findings.excerpt: sources indicated Marvell lost the designs for the Trainium 3 and 4 AI chips to Taiwan-based rival Alchip Technologies

findings.claim: The Information 報導 Microsoft 正評估 Broadcom 作為晶片設計夥伴（Maia）。
findings.source: AOL: Will Customer Defections Crumble Marvell Technology's AI Empire?
findings.excerpt: Microsoft is exploring Broadcom as a potential chip design partner

findings.claim: Marvell 管理層稱 FY2026 看不到來自 Amazon 的營收中斷；CEO 否認失去 Microsoft 或 Amazon 業務。
findings.source: 24/7 Wall St: Wall Street's Worry About Marvell Losing Customers Was Overblown
findings.excerpt: Marvell executives stated they see no revenue disruptions from Amazon in fiscal 2026.

customer_second_source.note: as_of 以文章日期近似；Alchip/Broadcom 為未證實報導。KeyBanc 稱 Marvell 承認 AWS 可能採雙供應策略，僅見摘要無逐字原文，未列。
